description: §47.1.1 — the clean control for server-db/reserved-prefix-raw-driver-pos: the same read written as a `?{}` query, with `_scrml_` appearing only in a comment, a string literal and markup prose. None of those is a name, so E-NAME-COLLIDES-RESERVED-PREFIX does not fire — and the compiler's own emitted `_scrml_` names (the lowered `?{}`, the handler wiring) never trip it. (-neg: the code does not fire.)
rationale: §47.1.1 S439 (#7) + S440 (#9): the reservation is on DECLARING or REFERENCING a name that begins with `_scrml_`. A comment, a string literal and markup text are not names; the compiler's own lowered output is not author source.
